tips.text: Stay in past round 4; with 3 or 4 conduits defended every round pays the C table, so one long run beats repeated 4-round resets.
Hold your Vessel Capillaries until you can buy every part you still lack; buying one early wastes them when a drop lands on it.
Defend all four conduits every round; it keeps the C table and raises Demolisher kills, which is where Capillaries come from.
Run Steel Path if your squad clears it comfortably; each Demolisher pays 5 to 7 Capillaries instead of 2 to 4.
Try soloing; public squads spread out and thin the spawns.
Finish The Deadlock Protocol as well if Armatus does not show on the map.
Expect two to three hours for a full Dante; the farm has a hard pity floor and almost nobody regrets it.
